name: Lac Operon Regulation
description: The lac operon is a classic example of prokaryotic gene regulation discovered by Jacob and Monod (Nobel Prize 1965). This detailed flowchart demonstrates the computational logic of bacterial gene regulation, showing how environmental inputs (lactose, glucose, energy status) are processed through regulatory logic gates (both OR and AND) to control gene expression and metabolic pathways. The system illustrates transcriptional control through the lac repressor, CAP-cAMP complex, and RNA polymerase, ultimately regulating lactose metabolism.
scientificAccuracy: This flowchart is based on verified biochemical and genetic data from peer-reviewed literature. All molecular components, regulatory mechanisms, and metabolic pathways have been validated against primary research sources. The model represents the current scientific consensus on lac operon regulation as established by decades of experimental work. Logic gates accurately represent the Boolean logic of transcriptional regulation.

verifiedBy: Literature review and comparison with primary sources
notes: This flowchart represents maximum complexity with 58 unique nodes (A-III + ANDGATE1 + ANDGATE2), each with distinct identifiers. Contains 3 OR logic gates (orange) and 2 AND logic gates (lavender). The explicit AND gates properly represent multi-signal integration: (1) High cAMP requires low energy AND no glucose, (2) Strong transcription requires operator free AND CAP bound. Final system states (Energy Production, Lactose Consumption, Cell Survival, Homeostasis, System Equilibrium) are colored blue as cellular states/conditions. Transcriptional outcomes (EE, FF, GG) are colored violet as functional outputs. The model includes environmental sensing, transport mechanisms, regulatory logic gates, transcription control, protein synthesis, metabolic functions, and feedback regulation. All molecular components and regulatory mechanisms have been validated against primary research sources. GAP (2026-07-20): CRP/LacI combinatorial AND is loop-mediated (Tier 3) but Loop nodes=0 — DNA loop is described in prose/mermaid, not encoded as loop topology. Circuit-class label pending Lents review.
circuitClassRationale: LacI repression + CAP activation; combinatorial CRP∩LacI AND (not homeostatic negative-feedback archetype). QA note: Mermaid topology has loops=0 despite loop-mediated AND; verify class, loop topology, node labels, and sequence annotation before using lac as the worked example. Label pending expert review.
